query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('clock',(SELECT event_time_utc FROM routelens_p05.namespace_clock WHERE namespace='p08-35a00106ef4342b1'),'traversals',(SELECT count(*) FROM routelens_p05.traversals WHERE namespace='p08-35a00106ef4342b1'),'publications',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) FROM (SELECT publisher_id,sequence,traffic_snapshot_id,encode(sha256(artifact),'hex') AS actual_artifact_sha256,octet_length(artifact) AS byte_length,published_at,valid_until FROM routelens_p07.publications WHERE namespace='p08-35a00106ef4342b1' ORDER BY publisher_id,sequence)p),'consumers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) FROM (SELECT consumer_id,high_water,last_snapshot_id,octet_length(artifact) AS active_byte_length FROM routelens_p07.consumer_states WHERE namespace='p08-35a00106ef4342b1' ORDER BY consumer_id)c));
